fact: The playbook says the unique citizen identifier (IUC), set up by decree-law 2020-17, is unique, non-significant and sequential, and is given at birth to every person entered in the civil status register.
The playbook says the IUC is given to any natural person entered in the civil status register at birth, with the register fed from the national civil status system Madania.
The deck says the 11-digit non-significant unique number, set up by decree-law of 12 May 2020, is assigned at birth or on obtaining Tunisian nationality.
